theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), IsOpen D → MeasurableSet F → (∀ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ φ : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ K → (∀ y, ‖φ y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ y : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) ≤ C) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), μ Dᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μ K ≠ ∞) ∧ Measurable ν ∧ (∀ y, ‖ν y‖ = 1) ∧ ∀ φ : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ y in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ y : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) = -∫ y, inner ℝ (φ y) (ν y) ∂μ
